title: [006] Mock-aware Rules Test API harness using the Firebase CLI login

violation.problem: Pyric-derived hosted cases omit exists()/get() mocks, and `--engine rules-test-api` accepts only service-account keys, so there is no repeatable hosted check.
violation.expectedSolution: Port the audit harness: read project from .firebaserc, refresh the CLI token in memory, call only `projects/{id}:test` with functionMocks, print a pyric/hosted/secure table, and exit 1 on mismatch. Never write credentials to disk.
